issues: A single line of 28px design-space monospace sat in the middle of black, under 5% of frame height, with nothing around it
Lock times were spaced evenly, so it read as a progress bar ticking at constant speed with no sense of computation
The lock flash was a 3f blue-white glow; in thumbnails you could barely tell which character had just locked
Cold blue-grey on a flat dark stage, with no terminal or system context: it looked like placeholder text
changes: Lime look (graphite black, fluorescent yellow-green) as a terminal poster: a two-line 168px bold monospace headline spanning ~55% of the frame, HUD header (system, build, T+ timer), decrypt progress bar and status line below, a blurred hex stream as texture on the right, and faint scanlines

Each lock now fires a fluorescent inverse block: a full-cell accent block behind the glyph with the glyph turning dark, held 2f then fading linearly over 4f; the lock front carries a cursor bar and glow, so every lock is visible

New rhythm: noise boots left to right at 0.5f per character, holds until 26f, then locks spread on an in-out curve (slow start, fast middle, slow finish) with up to 3f jitter; duration 96 to 130f with ~44f hold after the last lock

The payoff word ONLINE stays fluorescent after locking; when everything locks the bar fills, the status light blooms once, the status line changes to Link established and the hex stream slows to a stop
Frame 1 already has content (HUD, empty bar, dim placeholder dots) instead of the original 6f blank
